subject: [PATCH] proc/task_mmu: handle special PMDs in clear_refs and pagemap

2026-09-25.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's /proc/PID/pagemap and /proc/PID/clear_refs functionality. The issue arises when a special PMD (Page Map Directory) is installed from a PFN (Physical Frame Number) that does not have a corresponding memmap entry. This causes the kernel to oops when trying to read or write these mappings. To fix this, the patch uses vm_normal_folio_pmd and vm_normal_page_pmd functions instead of pmd_folio and page_folio in certain paths, allowing the kernel to handle special PMDs correctly. The patch has been tested on QEMU with a test driver and has been reported to resolve the issue.
